# codemyrules report - bulletproof-react (`apps/react-vite`)

Date: 2026-11-02.
Stacks: one JS/TS stack, `apps/react-vite` (ESLint 8.57.0, legacy `.eslintrc.cjs`, `@typescript-eslint/parser` 7, Vitest), handled by `eslint-pattern-rules`.
Backend: none (no `pom.xml`, `go.mod`, `pyproject.toml` and so on), so `backend-pattern-rules` did not run.
The Next.js apps were left alone, as the project CLAUDE.md asks.
No generated source folders (only `generators/` Plop templates, already ignored by ESLint).
Dependencies were installed from the lockfile with `yarn install --frozen-lockfile --ignore-scripts` (`node_modules/` is git-ignored); no new package was added and `package.json` is byte-identical.

## Selection

Picked, per the advance answer: every candidate whose convention is stated in `CLAUDE.md`, `AGENTS.md` or `docs/*.md`, design-shaping ones included.
Nothing was automatic (`config.json` mode is `ask`).
No general rules and no code-only conventions were picked; they are listed below.

## Rules built (frontend)

All are built-in rules (no custom rule files), because the legacy config has no local-rule mechanism and adding one would need a new package.
All live in `apps/react-vite/.eslintrc.cjs`, with the doc the convention comes from cited in each message.

| # | Convention (source) | Rule id | Severity | Open hits |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | One API client: no `axios` outside `src/lib/api-client.ts` (api-layer.md, AGENTS.md) | `no-restricted-imports` | error | 0 |
| 2 | One API client: no raw `fetch`, `window/globalThis/self.fetch` (same) | `no-restricted-globals`, `no-restricted-properties` | error | 0 |
| 3 | Forms only through `@/components/ui/form`: no `react-hook-form` import elsewhere (state-management.md, AGENTS.md) | `no-restricted-imports` | error | 0 |
| 4 | Route modules load lazily in `src/app/router.tsx`, only `./routes/app/root` static (performance.md, AGENTS.md) | `no-restricted-imports` | error | 0 |
| 5 | Query keys from query options; literal key arrays only inside `queryOptions`/`infiniteQueryOptions` (state-management.md:41) | `no-restricted-syntax` | error | 0 |
| 6 | Separate fetcher functions: `queryFn`/`mutationFn` never call `api.*` inline (api-layer.md, AGENTS.md) | `no-restricted-syntax` | error | 0 |
| 7 | HTML only through `DOMPurify.sanitize` in `dangerouslySetInnerHTML` (security.md, AGENTS.md) | `no-restricted-syntax` | error | 0 |
| 8 | `useState(() => compute())`, never `useState(compute())` (performance.md, AGENTS.md) | `no-restricted-syntax` | error | 0 |
| 9 | No nested `renderX` functions inside components, non-test files (components-and-styling.md, AGENTS.md) | `no-restricted-syntax` | error | 0 |
| 10 | Tests use MSW: no `vi.spyOn(x, 'fetch')`, `vi.stubGlobal('fetch')`, `vi.mock('axios' / '@/lib/api-client')`, `x.fetch = ...` (testing.md, AGENTS.md) | `no-restricted-syntax` (test files) | error | 0 |
| 11 | No barrel `index.ts` in features (project-structure.md:61) | `check-file/no-index` (`src/features/**`) | error | 0 |
| 12 | Hook files named `use-*.ts(x)` in `hooks/` folders (AGENTS.md) | `check-file/filename-naming-convention` | error | 0 |
| 13 | PascalCase / camelCase names (AGENTS.md) | `@typescript-eslint/naming-convention` | error | 0 |
| 14 | `@/` alias instead of parent-relative `../` imports (project-standards.md, AGENTS.md) | `@typescript-eslint/no-restricted-imports` | warn | 48 in 37 files |
| 15 | Icons from `lucide-react`, not `@radix-ui/react-icons` (AGENTS.md) | `@typescript-eslint/no-restricted-imports` | warn | 4 in 4 files |
| 16 | `Link` from `@/components/ui/link`, not `react-router` (components-and-styling.md) | `@typescript-eslint/no-restricted-imports` | warn | 2 in 2 files |
| 17 | Mutation success notifications live in the api hook's `onSuccess`; feature components never call `useNotifications` (api-layer.md:18) | `@typescript-eslint/no-restricted-imports` (`src/features/*/components/**`) | warn | 7 in 7 files |

A few hits:
- 14: `src/components/errors/main.tsx:1` (`../ui/button`), `src/features/discussions/components/discussions-list.tsx:10` (`../api/get-discussion`), `src/testing/mocks/handlers/auth.ts:6` (`../db`).
- 15: `src/components/ui/dialog/dialog.tsx:2`, `src/components/ui/drawer/drawer.tsx:2`, `src/components/ui/dropdown/dropdown.tsx:2`, `src/components/ui/table/pagination.tsx:1`.
- 16: `src/features/auth/components/login-form.tsx:1`, `src/features/auth/components/register-form.tsx:2`.
- 17: `src/features/comments/components/create-comment.tsx:5`, `src/features/discussions/components/update-discussion.tsx:5`, `src/features/users/components/update-profile.tsx:5`, and 4 more.

Every hit was read and is a violation under the agreed boundary.
One false positive found during verify was fixed: `NavLink` in `dashboard-layout.tsx` (the wrapper covers only `Link`, so `NavLink` is allowed).
The router exception for `./routes/app/root` needed a gitignore-style re-include chain, also fixed and checked.

Shared rule ids, counted together in the baseline:
- `no-restricted-syntax` holds rules 5 to 10.
- `@typescript-eslint/no-restricted-imports` holds the four warn-level conventions 14 to 17 (61 hits).
  They use this id only so they can stay at `warn` while the error-level `no-restricted-imports` stays separate.
  Promotion plan: fix the hits of one convention, then move its entry into the `no-restricted-imports` error list (`restrictedImport` in the config).

### Verify

- Each zero-hit rule was checked with temporary probe files (deleted afterwards): every violation form fired with its message, and every valid form stayed quiet (`queryKey` inside `queryOptions`, `okOptions().queryKey`, `useState(() => ...)`, sanitized HTML, `vi.mock('zustand')`, nested helpers in tests, `use-good.ts`).
- The project's own run, `eslint src --ignore-path .gitignore` in `apps/react-vite`, loads the config and exits 0 (61 warnings, 0 errors).
- The full build and test suite were not run, as asked.

### Config change (short diff)

```diff
 // apps/react-vite/.eslintrc.cjs
+const testFiles = ['**/__tests__/**', '**/*.test.ts', '**/*.test.tsx', 'src/testing/**'];
+const restrictedImport = { axios: {...}, reactHookForm: {...} };
+const restrictedSyntax = { queryKeyLiteral, queryClientKeyLiteral, inlineFetcher, unsanitizedHtml, eagerStateInit, nestedRenderFunction, mockedFetch };
+const legacyImport = { parentRelative, radixIcons, routerLink, notifications };
 ...
   '**/*.{ts,tsx}': 'KEBAB_CASE',
+  'src/**/hooks/*.{ts,tsx}': 'use-+([a-z0-9-])',
+'@typescript-eslint/naming-convention': ['error', function camel|Pascal, variable camel|Pascal|UPPER, typeLike Pascal],
+'no-restricted-imports': ['error', { paths: [axios, react-hook-form] }],
+'no-restricted-globals': ['error', fetch],
+'no-restricted-properties': ['error', window|globalThis|self .fetch],
+'no-restricted-syntax': sourceSyntax,
+'@typescript-eslint/no-restricted-imports': ['warn', radix-icons, react-router Link, '../*'],
+overrides: test files | src/lib/api-client.ts | src/components/ui/form/** | src/app/router.tsx
+           | src/components/ui/link/** | src/features/*/components/** | src/features/** (check-file/no-index)
```

Legacy overrides replace a rule's options per file, so each override restates the full entry list for its files.

## Agent-doc cleanup

Only `AGENTS.md` was edited.
`AGENTS.md` is always loaded (the root `CLAUDE.md` tells every session to read it).
`docs/*.md` were left as they are: they are the project's human guides, loaded on demand, and the rule messages now cite them.

Deleted (the rule message carries the line):
- `**PascalCase** for React components`, `**camelCase** for functions and variables` (rule 13)
- `**Extract render functions** - Move complex JSX into separate components` (rule 9)
- `Separate fetcher functions from hooks` (rule 6)
- `Use DOMPurify for HTML content sanitization` (rule 7)
- `**Route-level splitting** - Lazy load pages/routes` (rule 4)
- `**State initializer functions** - For expensive initial computations` (rule 8)
- `**Hooks**: use-kebab-case.ts` (rule 12)
- `**Lucide React** for icons` (rule 15)

Shortened to a pointer, kept in place in `AGENTS.md` (the rule spans all of `src/`, so the root doc is the right place):
- `**React Hook Form** for form management` + `Create reusable Form and Input components` became `Build forms with Form and the field components from @/components/ui/form, which wrap React Hook Form (enforced by ESLint)` (rule 3, design-shaping: a form built on raw `useForm` is a rewrite).

Kept as they are:
- `Absolute imports - Use @/ prefix for all src imports`: the rule covers only `../`; the `./` part is contradicted by the code (see below).
- `Use real HTTP requests with MSW instead of mocking fetch`: design-shaping for tests and already one short line.
- `Sanitize all user inputs before rendering`, the API Layer structure and example: broader than the rules.

Doc tokens removed: 418 characters, about 105 tokens, all always-loaded, so about 105 tokens less in every session.
On-demand tokens removed: 0.
The larger effect is not those tokens: it is the fix rounds the rules avoid, where an agent hears about a broken convention right after the edit instead of in review or CI.
`AGENTS.md` also describes the two Next.js apps; the deleted lines are no longer stated for them, and no rule guards them there (the project CLAUDE.md scopes agent work to `apps/react-vite`).

## Feedback loop

Installed, private: `.claude/settings.local.json` plus `.claude/codemyrules/`, both added to `.git/info/exclude`; no tracked file changed.

- Guard (`PreToolUse`): asks before any edit that adds an ignore comment, and before edits to the protected paths.
- Fast tier (after each edit): no linter; the project has no `eslint_d` and no `sgconfig.yml`.
  The edit hook only records the file for the end-of-turn check.
- Full tier (end of turn): `eslint-react-vite`, the project's ESLint run from `apps/react-vite` (ESLint 8 resolves plugins and the `@/` alias from there), through a small `sh -c` wrapper that keeps only files under `apps/react-vite/` and rebases their paths.
  Extensions: `.ts .tsx .js .jsx .cjs`.
- Protected paths: `apps/react-vite/.eslintrc.cjs`, `apps/react-vite/.prettierrc`, `apps/react-vite/tsconfig.json`, `apps/nextjs-app/.eslintrc.cjs`, `apps/nextjs-pages/.eslintrc.cjs`, plus `.claude/codemyrules/` and `.claude/settings.local.json`.
  Lint settings inside `package.json` (`lint-staged`) are not guarded.
- Smoke test: a clean edited file passed silently; a temporary file importing `axios` blocked the turn with `no-restricted-imports` and the fix instruction (exit 2); the test file and its log line were removed.
- Only errors block, so the four warn-level conventions (14 to 17) are invisible to the loop until they are promoted to `error`.
- Optional, for a fast tier: `yarn --cwd apps/react-vite add -D --exact eslint_d@<version>`, then add it as a `fast` linter.

## Baseline

`.claude/codemyrules/baseline.json`, written after the doc cleanup:
- always-loaded doc tokens: 2317 per session (root `CLAUDE.md` + `AGENTS.md`)
- on-demand doc tokens: 0
- rule ids: 8; open hits: 61, all in `@typescript-eslint/no-restricted-imports` (warn)

A later run of this skill compares against it with `measure.mjs report`.
A rule that fails often in `failures.log` needs a one-line pointer where the agent works.

## General rules offered and not picked

Counted in one ESLint run on `src`, without changing the config:
- `max-lines-per-function` 50 (skip blanks and comments): 18 hits in 17 files
- `no-console`: 2 hits in 2 files
- `no-else-return`: 2 hits in 2 files
- `react/no-danger`: 1 hit (`md-preview.tsx`, sanitized; rule 7 covers this safely)
- 0 hits: `complexity` 10, `max-depth` 4, `max-params` 3, `no-nested-ternary`, `max-lines` 400, `eqeqeq`, `no-constant-binary-expression`, `array-callback-return`, `no-self-compare`, `no-unreachable-loop`, `no-implied-eval`, `no-new-func`, `no-script-url`
- Need a type-aware config (`parserOptions.project`), not counted: `@typescript-eslint/no-floating-promises`, `no-misused-promises`, `switch-exhaustiveness-check`
- Report only: a secret scanner in CI (gitleaks or trufflehog), `knip` for unused files and exports

## Conventions not built

- `./` sibling imports versus "Use `@/` prefix for all src imports" (AGENTS.md): contradicted, 51 files use `./`; only `../` was built.
- Code-only conventions (not picked, per the advance answer):
  - env through `@/config/env`: 2 bypasses, `src/app/provider.tsx:36` (`import.meta.env.DEV`), `src/testing/mocks/utils.ts:33`
  - route URLs through `@/config/paths`: 12 files use it, no literal hrefs
- Not lintable as a rule: composition over props, limit prop count, single responsibility, colocation, error boundaries per feature, Zustand for global state, keep state local, type-first, types and schemas per endpoint, image optimization, Sentry.
- Token storage (AGENTS.md): permissive ("cookies preferred, or localStorage"), nothing to enforce.
- Already covered (notes): cross-feature imports and unidirectional flow (`import/no-restricted-paths`), kebab-case files and folders (`check-file`), formatting (`prettier/prettier`), hooks rules (`react-hooks`), strict TypeScript (`tsc`).

## Scan log

| Signal | Good | Bad | Verdict |
|---|---|---|---|
| `@/` imports vs `../` | 81 files with `@/` | 48 `../` imports, 37 files | built, warn |
| `./` sibling imports | - | 51 files | contradicted, not built |
| `useNotifications` in feature components vs api hooks | 0 in `api/` | 7 components | contradicted, enforced doc at warn |
| literal `queryKey` outside query options | 5 query option factories | 0 | built |
| `invalidateQueries` etc. with literal keys | 6 via `...QueryOptions().queryKey` | 0 | built |
| raw `fetch` / `axios` outside api-client | `@/lib/api-client` in 12 files | 0 | built |
| `dangerouslySetInnerHTML` without `sanitize` | 1 sanitized | 0 | built |
| nested `renderX` in components | - | 0 (2 test helpers at module level) | built |
| `useState(fn())` | - | 0 | built |
| fetch / client mocking in tests | MSW handlers | 0 (`vi.mock('zustand')` is allowed) | built |
| `react-hook-form` outside `ui/form` | 6 files inside | 0 | built |
| static route imports in router | 1 static (`app/root`, allowed) | 0 | built |
| `index.ts` in features | 13 barrels, all outside features | 0 | built |
| hook file names | 1 `use-*` | 0 | built |
| naming convention | - | 0 | built |
| `react-router` `Link` vs wrapper | 3 files use the wrapper | 2 | built, warn |
| `lucide-react` vs `@radix-ui/react-icons` | 11 imports | 4 | built, warn |
| `import.meta.env` outside config | - | 2 | code-only, not picked |
| suppression comments (`eslint-disable`, `@ts-*`) | - | 0 | nothing contradicted |
| type-aware signals (floating promises, exhaustive switch) | - | - | not probed: no type-aware config |

## Design answers given on the user's behalf

Nobody could answer during the run, so these are the recommended, safer choices; each can be changed with a one-line config edit.

1. Notifications (rule 17): the docs and code contradict (doc: components never call `useNotifications`; code: 7 components do, 0 hooks do).
   Chose to enforce the doc at `warn`, following the "pick everything the docs state" answer.
   Alternative: update `docs/api-layer.md:18` to match the code and drop the rule.
2. Absolute imports (rule 14): banned only `../`, at `warn`, test files included.
   Reason: `./` is used in 51 files and the docs' rationale is about `../../../` paths.
   Alternative: also ban `./` (AGENTS.md's literal wording), or exempt tests.
3. Warn-level conventions share `@typescript-eslint/no-restricted-imports` so severities can differ; they count together in the baseline.
   Alternative: custom `local/gen-*` rules, which would need `eslint-plugin-local-rules` (a new dev dependency and a `package.json` change).
4. Icons (rule 15) also apply to `src/components/ui`, where all 4 hits are.
   Alternative: exempt `src/components/ui/**` as copied ShadCN code.
5. Link (rule 16) covers `Link` only, not `NavLink`, because the wrapper wraps only `Link`.
6. Barrels (rule 11) are banned only in `src/features/**`; `src/components/ui` keeps its index files.
7. Naming (rule 13) is loose (functions camelCase or PascalCase; variables also UPPER_CASE), matching the code with 0 hits.
   Alternative: stricter per-selector formats.
8. New rules with no open hits are `error`, so the loop shows them; rules with hits are `warn` with the promotion plan above.
9. `docs/*.md` were not edited; only always-loaded `AGENTS.md` lines were deleted or shortened.
   Alternative: also trim the covered lines in `docs/` (on demand, so no per-session token saving).

result:
I ran codemyrules on `apps/react-vite`. It turned 17 conventions from `AGENTS.md` and `docs/*.md` into ESLint rules, trimmed the `AGENTS.md` lines those rules now cover, installed the private feedback loop and wrote the baseline. The project's own `eslint src` run passes: 0 errors and 61 warnings. As you asked, I did not run the build or the test suite.

Two decisions you should check:
- **Notifications:** `docs/api-layer.md` says feature components never call `useNotifications`, but 7 components do. I enforced the doc as a warning. The other option is to change the doc to match the code.
- **Next.js apps:** the lines I deleted from `AGENTS.md` also covered the two Next.js apps, and no rule checks those.

`docs/*.md` is unchanged, and nothing was committed. Besides the report, I added a short `notes/` folder as your workspace CLAUDE.md asks.
